Name: Watering Path
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b]WateringPath[/b] adds a new decorative yet functional tile to Stardew Valley — the [i]Water Channel Tile[/i].
This tile is not just for looks — it helps you manage your crops more efficiently with immersive effects.

 Features:[list]
[*][b]Auto-waters soil[/b] within 1 tile radius every morning
[*][b]Walkable[/b] like regular paths — perfect for farm design
[*][b]Water sound[/b] plays when walking over it
[*][b]Refills watering can[/b] automatically when standing on it
[/list]Bring life to your farm with flowing water,
and enjoy a beautiful, practical upgrade to your everyday farming experience.

Users are free to edit/replace the tile asset for personal use.
